reviews.comment:
Un parto... pedir cafe una fila.... pagar cafe, otra fila.. retirar el cafe que pediste, otra fila y ademas te salen diciendo que medialunas no tienen.. q de membrillo no tienen... ok.. deme lo q se te de la gana y punto.... el patio exterior un asco los empleados parece q arrancaron hace 10 minutos.
Las IPF comunes son mil veces mas organizados.
Menos mal que son del ACA

(Translated by Google)
A nightmare... ordering coffee, one line... paying for coffee, another line... picking up your coffee, yet another line, and then they tell you they don't have croissants... or quince paste... okay... give me whatever you want, period.... the outdoor patio is disgusting, the employees seem like they just started 10 minutes ago.
Regular IPF stores are a thousand times more organized. Thank goodness they're part of the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina).

reviews.comment:
Baños limpios.
La comida mala. La hamburguesa esta tibia, con un pan seco y la hamburguesa igual, el queso ni calentito como para derretirse. Lo que si estaban bien son las papas. Esas si estaban hechas en el momento.
Tiene un lindo parque para descansar un rato
De la ruta. Si tenes ganas de comer hamburguesas un par de km mas para el norte, esta la cadena de hambuerguesas del dibu.

(Translated by Google)
Clean bathrooms.
The food was bad. The hamburger was lukewarm, with a dry bun and a dry patty; the cheese wasn't even warm enough to melt. The fries were good, though. They were freshly made.
It has a nice park to rest for a while. It's off the main road. If you're in the mood for hamburgers, a couple of kilometers further north there's the Dibu burger chain.
